rationale: Two BISPF native families and the semantic observation extension have not met the joint donor/cell target. Test the released BCAP preset as a third pure formulation, rather than tune evaluation targets. Its input-gradient-cap critic penalty and zero prior penalty change the optimization geometry relative to optimized BISPF. Improvement is a hypothesis, not established by previous failures.
unchanged: 33 optimization donors, preprocessing, 150 fixed moments/Fourier observations, count model, discrete forward/declared biased Gamma-rate backward, data batches/library law, deterministic streams, direct iter_pg, 0 real bag replacements, 4 calibration donors and 2 fixed generation replicates.20 evaluation donors excluded.
confounds: Whole native recipe comparison. BCAP changes critic penalty, prior regularization weight, convolution update rule/backend and declared training precision relative to optimized BISPF. Not a single-component causal ablation. No performance or natural-image claim.
qualification: Finite nonzero G/dispersion/prior gradients and complete serialized next-update bitwise equality
selection: Compare pure_incumbent by existing donorES primary/cellED nonregression/spread guard; no threshold or cohort changes. Commit candidate plan enabled=true before launch, evidence commit plus actual revert on failure/regression. Joint baseline target and matched three-seed confirmation still required.
native_prior_buffers: BCAP has only z; optimized BISPF adds moment_tether_mean/covariance/count native SBNP reference buffers. These are a declared native-preset difference; initialization parity applies to learned parameters, not complete prior state dictionaries.
